CONDITIONS PRECEDENT TO CLOSING — Harborlight / Northgale acquisition

CP-1 Board approval of Seller — SATISFIED (resolution dated 2026-07-14 in the closing set).
CP-2 Board approval of Buyer — SATISFIED (resolution dated 2026-07-16).
CP-3 Third-party consent: Harborlight's largest customer contract contains a change-of-control clause requiring written consent — OUTSTANDING; consent requested 2026-07-02, no response received.
CP-4 Payoff letter from senior lender — SATISFIED (letter dated 2026-08-03).
CP-5 Officer's certificate as to representations — SATISFIED (executed 2026-08-07).
CP-6 Escrow agreement executed by all parties — SATISFIED.

Closing determination vocabulary (use exactly): clear_to_close | cannot_close_open_conditions

SIGNATURE PAGE STATUS — closing set

Purchase Agreement: Buyer signed, Seller signed, escrow agent signed — COMPLETE.
Escrow Agreement: all three parties signed — COMPLETE.
IP Assignment: assignor signed; assignee signature page received and held in escrow — COMPLETE.
Transition Services Agreement: Buyer signed; SELLER SIGNATURE OUTSTANDING.

Note: the TSA is a closing deliverable listed in Schedule 2.4 but is NOT a condition precedent under Article 7.
